title: Identify the names of cards illustrated by Stephen Daniele that are legal i
question: Identify the names of cards illustrated by Stephen Daniele that are legal in the Commander format and have unknown power (either null or '*'). Among these, return only those whose converted mana cost is greater than the average converted mana cost of all cards in the 'Journey into Nyx Hero''s Path' set.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Stephen Daniele'
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'commander'
  AND T2."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND T1."XCL_011" > (
    SELECT AVG(T3."XCL_011")
    FROM cards AS T3
    INNER JOIN sets AS T4 ON T3."XCL_063" = T4."XCL_099"
    WHERE T4."XCL_110" = 'Journey into Nyx Hero''s Path'
  )
